reason: All 5 linux_riscv64 CI jobs fail with the same solver error: cross-python_linux-riscv64 does not exist. This is a conda-forge packaging gap (cross-python feedstock hasn't published a riscv64 build) that must be fixed upstream in the cross-python feedstock before this PR's riscv64 jobs can pass; all other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, win_64, win_arm64, osx) pass cleanly.
